data.title: FC Augsburg vs. SC Freiburg preview: Hosts looking to end five-game winless run - Yahoo Sports
data.content:
Despite their recent Bundesliga struggles, the hosts have not lost at the WWK Arena in seven months, and Baum will hope to extend that impressive record on Saturday.

Team news

Augsburg will be without Juma Bah, who is suspended after his red card against Union Berlin last weekend.

Calvin Brackelmann is also unavailable as he continues to recover from the concussion he sustained in the same match, while Noahkai Banks and Steve Mounié remain sidelined.
